english: It's so slow, nyo...\nEvery now and then there are times\nwith no customers, nyo~.
If I strung all these short slow stretches together into one day,\nI could really get my doujinshi work done, nyo.
Still, I can't slack off on shop duty, nyo.
To keep from getting sleepy,\nI'll do a patrol of the store, nyo.\nStarting with the gal-game corner, nyo.
[Event art: Dejiko with sparkling eyes - "Buy something, nyo!"]
Hellooo, nyo.\nLooking for something, nyo?
You sure got a lot of games here.\nWhich one's fun?
Whether it's fun is up to you, nyo.\nDejiko believes anyone who can enjoy any game\nis a true gamer, nyo!
Huh, the clerk says funny stuff!\nSo, so.\nYou got a game where a phantom thief beats a detective?
Hoho, the reverse of the usual, nyo.\nDejiko would like to try a game like that too, nyo!
Right? So, got anything like that?
I believe we had games like Paroon the Third\nor Phantom Thief Kido, nyo.
Don't need the Third one.\nThe Phantom Thief Kido game sounds interesting, though.
Just buy something, anything, nyo!!
[Event art off / BG: inside the Gamers store]
Also, where are the limited editions\nand rare stuff?\nNot on these shelves, right?
That's on the 5th floor, nyo.
Like, super-rare stuff you can't even put a price on...?
Gamers' selection is the best in the universe, nyo.\nBut we can't sell items like that, nyo.
Ehh, you won't sell it to me?\nThen never mind.
Huh?\nYou asked all those questions and you're not buying anything, nyo!?
Just window-shopping, nyo!\nGive me back my precious time, nyo!
...Well, at least she wasn't shoplifting.\nI'll count that as a win, nyo.
Lately, there seem to be more and more\ntroublemakers in Akihabara, nyo!\nThey can't fool Dejiko's eyes, nyo!!
I've got evil-heart-detecting sensors\nset up in this store, so\nif they react, it's instant eye-beams, nyo!!
Anyway, Akihabara-with yours truly Dejiko at the top-\nmust be a town of youngsters and middle-aged youngsters\nwho buy things, nyo.
Phew, I'm tired from passionately speechifying\nin an empty store, nyo.\nBack to zoning out, nyo~.
Dejiko, it's terrible, nyu.
Oh, it's Puchiko, nyo~.\nHere to switch shop duty, nyo~?
We just switched a minute ago, nyu.\nMore importantly, it's bad outside, nyu.
What's wrong, nyo~.\nIs that manga-loving ex-prime minister\ngiving a speech or something, nyo?
It's an enemy attack, nyu.
Enemy attack?\nIs some giant game store or anime store\nhanding out sale flyers, nyo?
Just come, nyu!!
Fine, fine, I'm bored anyway, so I'll take a look, nyo~.
[BG: Akihabara streets (day)]
*murmur...*
*murmur... murmur...*
Wh-what is that, nyo!?\nNo matter how you look at it, there's a swarm of something not-human, nyo!
The town's under attack, nyu.
Hoho... so that's a challenge\nissued to Dejiko, nyo?
You do something about it, nyu.
You don't even have to ask, nyo!\nAkihabara is Dejiko-sama's turf, nyo!\nI won't let outsiders act all big-shot here, nyo!
Good luck, nyu.
Puchiko's coming too, nyo!
You said you'd handle it on your own, nyu.
Don't say that, come with me, nyo!\nIt's lonely going alone, nyo...
Can't be helped, nyu.
[Switch to battle map / after units are placed]
Oooh, there's quite a lot of them, nyo...
If you're gonna chicken out, don't act tough, nyu.
There are times a man must do what he must, nyo!\nWhether it's a giant game store or a giant anime store,\nI won't forgive interference with business, nyo!!
Your mouth is the interference with business, nyu.\nAlso, since when are you a man, nyu.
Details don't matter, nyo!!\nCommencing armed intervention, nyo!!
[Battle starts / Yase appears after defeating a set number of enemies]
Hm? What is this place?\nSo tacky, and the air's awful... what a nasty place.
Something came out, nyo!
You there, who are you?\nTell me in ten seconds.
I'm Dejiko, nyo!\nMy real name's Chocolat, nyo!
But I ended up with the name De Ji Charat, nyo.\nSo just call me Dejiko, nyo.
Puchiko, nyu.\nMy real name's Cappuccino, nyu.
They also call me Petit Charat, nyu.\nBut Puchiko's fine, nyu.
How's that, nyo? H-how many seconds did that take, nyo!?
Oh my, sorry.\nI wasn't counting.
Then don't give me a time limit, nyo!!
Useless, nyu.
I'm looking for someone.\nHer name's Koto - know her?
Koto, nyo?\nNone of Dejiko's acquaintances, nyo.
You just answered without thinking, didn't you?\nAre you making fun of me, by any chance?
That's not it at all, nyo.
(Ugh, I got tangled up with a real pain, nyo...)
I can hear you, you know. Who's a pain?
Nyo!? You've got the ears of a demon, nyo!!
Fine. I'll just capture you\nand take my time asking.
[Yase summons a horde of youkai]
A whole bunch of somethings came out, nyo!?
It's your fault, nyu.
[Battle resumes / event during battle with Yase]
My, my... how amusing.
Nyo-nyo!?\nShe's too strong, nyo! This is cheating, nyo!
Because you charged in recklessly, nyu.
Giving up...?
(This is bad, this is bad, nyo...!)
[Light appears; the party arrives]
What is it this time, nyo!?
Where in the world is this? It looks like a city, though?
Wah, it's Akihabara!\nI can see the Gamers store...!
Akihabara? Weird name.\nAnd what's with this place? Building towers all over\nsuch a cramped place. Are they stupid?
Halkeginia was nice and spacious, after all.
You people...!?
It's our chance, nyo!!
Chance for what, nyu?
To run away, nyo!!
[Dejiko flees. To the edge of the screen.]
Sheesh, I thought you weren't gonna\nlet them act all big-shot, nyu.
This is not defeat! It's a strategic retreat, nyo!
[Dejiko vanishes. / Puchiko follows, vanishing too.]
So uncool, nyu.
...What was that thing that just ran off?
Anyway, the one here\nis the youkai from Kyou-to, right?
You know Kyou-to?\nThen you know Koto, don't you?
Yes, I do.\nBut she's not here...
It won't do you any good to hide her, you know?
You're picking a fight!?
What IS this thing? Some kind of monster?
Is the little one over there\na hick who never learned\nhow to speak politely, I wonder?
What did you say!?\nHow dare you speak to a noble like that!!
U-um, fighting is...
I hate humans.
I'll make you suffer plenty!
[Battle resumes]
...With this much flash,\nKoto would've happily come jumping out by now.\nShe really doesn't seem to be here.
...Tch, it was a bum tip...!
[Yase vanishes]
...What is going on?\nAttacking out of nowhere, then vanishing on her own.
Is she an acquaintance of Koto-chan?\nShe was really beautiful~!
More importantly, is Tiffa here?\nI forgot to ask that one earlier.
For now, why don't we calm down and think?
[Battle ends]
Hmm, it's a peaceful town, at least on the surface.
Yes! There are so many people,\nsometimes I feel like I'll get swept away...\n...ehehe.
Still, nothing but strange buildings.\nThey're too thick to be towers...
These are buildings!
Biru? Who's that!?\nWhy does it have a name?
Um, 'biru' is short for\n'building'...
Hmph, how confusing.
It's like an English lesson♪\nTeacher Aoi-chan♪
When we went to Louise-chan's world,\nwe were surprised by all kinds of things like this too.
I see, so it's the reverse this time.
It's full of fresh surprises.
But it still hasn't clicked for me.\nWhat this world, this town is like.
In that case... how about we go to\nthe store called Gamers?\nI'll show you the way!
Gamers?
Yes! I thought it might help you\nunderstand what Akihabara is like...
Before that, may I have a moment!
Wah, Hibiki-chan? Is something wrong?
Something's been bugging me for a while,\njust for a bit is fine,\nwon't you come over there with me?
Over there?
[Scene change / Event art: Hibiki takes on the UFO catcher (and sucks at it)]
Damn it... didn't get it again.
Is it this doll you want?
Yeah... I've been away for so long,\nif I don't bring back at least a souvenir,\nmy roommate'll kill me.
Just one more time, I'll try again!
What is this thing?\nIf you want it, just buy it.
This is a game where you grab a doll.\nThe grabbing part is the important part.
It's actually pretty hard... ahh!\n...It went to the back.
If I used magic, this'd be easy...
Louise-san, winning it with your own strength\nis where the joy lies.
Unyuu, but it doesn't look winnable-uu.\nIf you just stabbed the arm\ninto the doll, you'd definitely get it-uu.
Um, that idea scares me...
That arm lacks power!
And it lacks the guts\nto never let go once it grabs its target!\nHonestly!! It needs more training.
Um, if it's too strong,\nthe doll will get torn to shreds...
Aaah! Failed again!!
[Event art off / BG: Akihabara]
Uu, I'm sorry, Sonico-san...\nI'll pay you back someday, I promise.
Aww, don't worry about it!\nIf you had fun, that's what matters most♪
You really sucked at that.\nPlaying that much and not winning a single one.
I... might be cursed...
If we go to Gamers,\nI'm sure you'll find a souvenir!
Really!?
Yes♪\nThey've got lots of cute and fun stuff♪
